rules.condition: website collects personal data through a public web form
rules.test: For each static form collecting likely PD: find policy link on collection page; verify linked document separately; never infer full compliance from mere link.
rules.human_check: Verify published policy accessible on PD collection pages, including JS rendering; inspect actual contents and covered data processing.

rules.condition: processing is based specifically on consent
rules.test: Within likely-PD forms flag checked-by-default consent and combined confirmations, as conditional risks only.
rules.human_check: Is consent actually the legal basis? Does UI sign more than one document? Does checkbox represent explicit consent?

rules.condition: material qualifies as online advertising under applicable rules
rules.test: presence of advertising label, advertiser identification, erid markers
rules.human_check: Is the material advertising or information about own business? Is this ad subject to labeling and registration requirements?

rules.condition: B2C product or service offered to consumers in Russian Federation
rules.test: Classify possible purchase scenario and locate seller identity; low-confidence triage only.
rules.human_check: Classify B2B vs B2C and transactional model; inspect full customer flow.

rules.condition: collection of Russian citizens' personal data with relevant statutory scope/exceptions
rules.test: manual / infrastructure documents only; IP geolocation is not proof
rules.human_check: Data flow map, storage location and processing infrastructure.
Security controls, access policies, data retention and incident procedures.

rules.condition: operator notification requirement, subject to exceptions
rules.test: requires operator identity and authoritative registry access
rules.human_check: Resolve legal entity and current status in RKN registry, review exceptions.

rules.article: требования к применению ККТ с учётом исключений
rules.condition: payment and settlement scenarios in scope
rules.test: manual payment test only, never submit payments in passive scanner
rules.human_check: Settlement model, receipt delivery, exceptions and payment provider configuration.

rules.condition: consumer-facing public information in scope, subject to exceptions
rules.test: manual linguistic review; Latin script alone is not a violation
rules.human_check: Check trademarks, product names, audience and required translation.

methodology.risk_terminology: potential_risk and needs_review are not a binding legal verdict
